description:
Raise confidence in paid desktop delivery by deepening automated assurance around Stripe-backed checkout, fulfillment, and entitlement enforcement.

This should extend test coverage around:
- checkout session creation and failure handling
- webhook validation, retries, and idempotency
- payment-to-entitlement fulfillment for desktop access
- download gating and post-payment access control
- coupon, intro-offer, and free-access abuse cases
- regressions where customers pay but do not receive service, or receive service without valid payment
- security-sensitive flows that could leak paid functionality

Goal: monetized desktop delivery is reliable enough to launch and hard to exploit in obvious ways.
name: lpbs-stripe-monetization-assurance-suite
title: Deepen LPBS Stripe Monetization Assurance
